page.layout: One printed page of running text in a single column. Running head above the text, page number 12 at the head. No marginal notes. Catchword "tunc" at the foot, right.

main_text.p: tiam cujus illos accusabam, præter æquum & liberum forum requirerem.

Nullâ hîc irritabat offensione, nec vindi-ctæ appetitu contra ipsos privatim nisi in quan-tum me certo deprehendisse existimarem quàm nefaria Consilia injissent, & quàm illicitis Federibus ad turbanda mihi Regna se obstrin-xissent:quorum omnium ut fidem facerem, minimum abfuit ne Chirographa eorum produ-cerem, qui tumultus sequentes excitassent.

Secus visum est Providentiæ. Non tamen deerant argumenta efficacia ad excitandas su-spiciones in Principis animo, qui non stupidè vecors omnem curam publicæ tranquillitatis abjecerat: cui ut consulerem, postulando ut in quinque vel sex homines æquo & legitimo ju-dicio inquireretur, (quod Deum testor, uni-cus mihi finis erat) quid inde pejus evenisset si obtinuissem quod volui,quàm, ut vel illis son-tibus deprehensis, asserta esset causa mea, & Regni mei; vel patefactâ ipsorum innocentiâ, suspiciones meæ omnes abstergerentur, quas, ut nullâ malitiâ ortas, ita Ratio non permisit suffocari.
In quas flammas odiorum hæc scintilla (quam omni modo extinguere conabar) brevi tempore eruperit, nimis notum mundo est.

Quod verè nonnulli calumniabantur, quasi per vim graffari in Domum Inferiorem, & Privilegia invadere destinassem, erat omnium falsissimum; cùm Deum testor, nec in mentem tale quicquam venisset, nec qui mecum

page.notes: No marginal notes. Right and left edges show stains and show-through only, not transcribed. The running head is Greek and was read as ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ; the Eta and Lambda are somewhat blurred. Doubtful: "exîstimarem" (possible circumflex, not certain); italic status of "Consilia" and "Federibus" read from the scan. Printing faults left as printed: "volui,quàm," (missing space) and "Consilia" with long s and the colon in "xissent:quorum" and "facerem,mi-" (missing space). The last line "tunc" is the catchword, not running text.
